description: Google has detailed how its upcoming Android backup storage policy will work after notifying users by email. The change will make device backups consume Google Account storage and pause automatic backups if available space runs out. Users will also gain more control over backup content on Android 9 and newer devices, while the Google One storage manager will show backup size and offer storage management options.
title: Google Reportedly Begins Rolling Out Android Backup Storage Policy Update

description: An Amazon India listing suggests that Google's Fitbit Air could launch in the country soon. The wearable offers continuous health monitoring, automatic workout detection, AI-powered coaching through Google Health Coach and a claimed battery life of up to seven days. It was first unveiled in the US in May 2026 as Google's latest Fitbit-branded health tracker.
title: Google's Fitbit Air Spotted on Amazon India Ahead of Official Launch

description: Telegram has announced a major update to its platform. The update introduces a Rich Text Editor, Telegram Communities, Ephemeral Bot Messages, and an expanded GIF search with over 350 million GIFs. Rich Text Editor allows users to create formatted messages with support for headings, tables, lists, quotes, and code blocks. Telegram has also added Communities to organise related groups, channels, and bots around a shared topic.
title: Telegram Gets New Rich Text Editor, Communities, and Ephemeral Bot Messages

description: With just three days to go till the Galaxy Unpacked event, rumours about Samsung’s upcoming products are now surfacing rapidly. While the South Korean tech conglomerate has yet to announce any details about its upcoming products, a fresh leak has revealed official-looking marketing images of the upcoming Galaxy wearables, dubbed the Galaxy Watch 9 and Galaxy Watch Ultra 2. The images, shared by a tipster, suggest that both smartwatches could be powered by Qualcomm's Snapdragon Wear Elite SoC.
title: Samsung Galaxy Watch 9, Galaxy Watch Ultra 2 Design, Key Specifications Reportedly Leak Ahead of Launch

description: Oppo appears to have hiked the prices of Oppo K14, Oppo K14x and Oppo A6s smartphones in India by up to Rs. 4,000. The likely reason behind this price change is the rising cost of memory chips. The Oppo K14, Oppo K14x and Oppo A6s ship with the MediaTek Dimensity 6300 chipset. They feature 6.75-inch displays and dual rear camera units headlined by a 50-megapixel primary sensor.
title: Oppo K14, K14x and A6s Reportedly Receive Price Hikes in India: Check New Pricing

description: Xiaomi has confirmed that the Xiaomi Power Bank 5i 20000mAh 67W will launch in India on July 23. The company has revealed key features through its India landing page, while the remaining specifications are expected to match the globally available model. The power bank is expected to support 67W output, 65W input, triple-device charging, and a built-in USB Type-C cable. It is also tipped to include a digital display, multiple safety features, and airline-compliant rated energy.
title: Xiaomi Power Bank 5i 20000mAh India Launch Date Confirmed; Key Features, Availability Details Revealed

description: Portronics Pure Sound Pro X2 home theatre system launched in India. The new 5.1-channel audio system offers 150W output. The setup comprises a soundbar with three 2-inch drivers, a 4.5-inch subwoofer, and two 2-inch satellite speakers. The soundbar features onboard controls for quick access to playback and volume. It has four EQ modes and offers Bluetooth 5.3 connectivity.
title: Portronics Pure Sound Pro X2 Home Theatre System Launched in India With 150W Sound Output, Four EQ Modes

description: The Moto Pad 70 was launched in India last month. The company is now gearing up to introduce another model in the form of the Moto Pad 70 Groove. The tablet will be launched in the country in July. Alongside its launch date, the brand has confirmed key features of the upcoming device. It will sport a 12.1-inch display with a 120Hz refresh rate. The Moto Pad 70 Groove will have a nine-speaker JBL audio system. It is confirmed to pack a 10,200mAh battery.
title: Moto Pad 70 Groove India Launch Date Announced; to Feature 9-Speaker JBL Audio System

description: Samsung has announced its 'Back to School' campaign in India. This special sale, designed for students, offers discounts and student-exclusive offers across the Galaxy S26 series, Galaxy Book 6 Pro, Galaxy Tab S11 Ultra, Smart Monitor M8, Galaxy Watch 8, Galaxy Buds 4 series, among others. As part of the campaign, students can purcahse the standard Galaxy S26 starting at Rs. 3,917 per month. Students purchasing the Galaxy Book 6 Pro and Galaxy Tab S11 Ultra using HDFC Bank cards will get up to Rs. 5,000 discount.
title: Samsung's 'Back to School' Sale Brings Discounts on Galaxy S26 Series, Galaxy Book 6 Pro, Galaxy Tab S11 Ultra and More

description: Vivo has announced the Vivo X300 E in China and opened pre-orders ahead of its July 27 debut. Early buyers will receive an extended warranty, a three-year battery protection plan, and a limited-edition power bank. While Vivo has not disclosed the complete specifications, earlier reports suggest the smartphone will feature a Snapdragon 8 Gen 5 chipset, a 6.59-inch 1.5K OLED display, Zeiss-backed cameras, and 90W fast charging. Pricing is expected to be revealed closer to the first sale.
title: Vivo X300 E Launch Date Confirmed; Pre-Orders Offers and Key Features Revealed

description: A new leak has revealed key specifications of the rumoured Oppo A7 Pro Max ahead of its expected debut. The smartphone is tipped to feature a 10,000mAh single-cell battery with 80W fast charging, a Snapdragon 4 Gen 5 chipset, and a 6.78-inch 1.5K OLED display with a 120Hz refresh rate. It may also include dual rear cameras, a 50-megapixel selfie camera, and a slim 8.47mm profile despite its large battery. Oppo has not confirmed the device.
title: Oppo A7 Pro Max Tipped to Feature 10,000mAh Battery, Snapdragon 4 Gen 5 SoC, and More

description: The Motorola Edge 70 Max is now available for purchase in India, following its launch last week. It is the fifth model in the company’s latest Edge lineup, which already comprises the Edge 70, Edge 70 Fusion, Edge 70 Pro, and Edge 70 Pro+. The handset sports a 6.8-inch Extreme AMOLED screen with a 144Hz refresh rate. It is powered by the Snapdragon 8 Gen 5 chipset, coupled with up to 12GB of RAM. The Motorola Edge 70 Max runs on Android 16 and packs a 7,100mAh battery.
title: Motorola Edge 70 Max Goes on Sale in India With Snapdragon 8 Gen 5 SoC: Price, Offers

description: The NSE-listed company expects smart TVs and large appliances to become its biggest revenue drivers while expanding its presence across India and overseas.
title: From Feature Phones to Smart TVs: How Cellecor Plans to Reach Rs. 2,000 Crore Revenue This Year

description: Xiaomi will reportedly launch the Xiaomi 18 series in India in December. For comparison, Xiaomi 17, Xiaomi 17 Pro and Xiaomi 17 Pro Max were introduced in China in September 2025. The Xiaomi 17 and Xiaomi 17 Ultra were later launched in the Indian market in March this year. The Xiaomi 18 series is expected to include three models, and they could run on the Qualcomm Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 Pro chipset.
title: Xiaomi 18 Series Tipped to Launch Early in India; Ultra Model Said to Be Replaced By Pro Max Variant

description: The Poco M8 Power has been rumoured to be in development for quite some time, and its launch could finally be on the horizon. The company has teased the arrival of the upcoming smartphone through a dedicated microsite on Flipkart. While the teaser does not reveal any specifications or a launch date, previous leaks have already shed light on the handset's expected hardware. The Poco M8 Power is tipped to arrive as a rebadged version of the Redmi Note 17 and could carry similar features.
title: Poco M8 Power India Launch Teased; Flipkart Availability Confirmed: Here's What You Need to Know

description: Honor X7e Plus 5G has been launched in select global markets with an 8,100mAh battery. It features a dedicated side button that lets users launch commands and apps instantly with a single press. It has a  6.87-inch HD+ display and a 50-megapixel rear camera unit. The new phone is offered in three colour options. The Honor X7e Plus 5G has IP68, IP69, and IP69K water and dust resistance.
title: Honor X7e Plus 5G Launched With Snapdragon 4 Gen 4 SoC, 8,100mAh Battery: Price, Specifications

description: Apple is said to have developed more powerful versions of its proprietary M2 and M3-series processors before deciding against bringing them to market. According to a seasoned journalist, the Cupertino-based tech giant worked on M2 Extreme and M3 Extreme chips in 2022, which would sit above the existing Ultra lineup. These SoCs would reportedly have featured twice the CPU and GPU core counts offered by Apple's Ultra chips at the time.
title: Apple Cancelled High-End M2 Extreme and M3 Extreme Chips Over Cost Concerns: Report

description: Freshly leaked promotional material is said to reveal Samsung's next generation foldable smartphones before their expected debut on July 22. The Galaxy Z Fold 8 is tipped to feature dual 50-megapixel rear cameras and the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 for Galaxy chipset, while the Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ultra could gain a new 50-megapixel ultra-wide camera and a 5,000mAh battery. The Galaxy Z Flip 8 is also expected to retain its 4,300mAh battery and offer enhanced cover screen functionality.
title: Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8, Z Fold 8 Ultra, and Z Flip 8 Marketing Images Leaked Ahead of July 22 Launch

description: A new leak suggests the OnePlus 16 and Oppo Find X10 Ultra may not launch in India, despite OnePlus previously confirming that it would continue operating in the country. A tipster claims the Oppo Find X10 Pro Max could become the brand's flagship offering in India in 2027. The leak also reveals key specifications, including a Dimensity 9600 Pro chipset, up to a 9,000mAh battery, and multiple 200-megapixel rear cameras. Neither Oppo nor OnePlus has confirmed the report.
title: OnePlus 16 India Launch in Doubt, Oppo Find X10 Ultra May Also Skip Market

description: Samsung is believed to overhaul its foldable lineup this year. The Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ultra is expected to debut as a successor to last year's Galaxy Z Fold 7, while the Galaxy Z Fold 8 is likely to be the first wide-folding handset with a passport-like design. The company will reportedly produce 2.8 million units of the Galaxy Z Fold 8 this year, outpacing the production targets of both the Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ultra and the Galaxy Z Flip 8.
title: Samsung Prioritises Galaxy Z Fold 8 With 2.8 Million Unit Production Target: Report

description: Apple has increased the prices of its Apple Music and Apple One subscription plans for both new and existing subscribers in India. The revised pricing is already live across both Apple platforms and affects multiple tiers, including Apple Music’s Individual, Family, and Student plans, as well as Apple One bundles. The latest revision comes less than two years after Apple last increased Apple Music subscription prices.
title: Apple Music, Apple One Subscription Prices Increased in India; Individual Plan Now Starts at Rs. 139

description: Google is rumoured to be developing its next affordable A-series smartphone, and its clues were recently discovered in the Phone app. The purported handset, dubbed the Pixel 11a, has now surfaced in a fresh leak, which reveals several of its key specifications, including the chipset, display, battery, cameras, and colour options. A tipster has suggested it could sport a 6.3-inch 120Hz display. The Google Pixel 11a is tipped to be powered by the upcoming Tensor G6 SoC.
title: Google Pixel 11a Key Specifications, Colour Options Leak; May Get Tensor G6 Chip, MediaTek Modem
